title: Plant Operations Manager
description: Lead day-to-day operations at our CPCB-authorized recycling facility. You will oversee the dismantling, segregation, and processing of e-waste and plastic waste while ensuring compliance with environmental regulations and safety standards.
requirements: 5+ years of experience in waste management or manufacturing operations
Knowledge of CPCB / SPCB regulations and environmental compliance
Strong leadership and team management skills
B.E. / B.Tech in Environmental, Mechanical, or Chemical Engineering
Experience with ISO 14001 and OHSAS 18001 standards

title: EPR Compliance Executive
description: Manage EPR documentation, filings, and reporting for our clients. You will coordinate with CPCB/SPCB, prepare annual returns, and ensure producers and importers meet their extended producer responsibility targets.
requirements: 2+ years of experience in EPR compliance or environmental consulting
In-depth understanding of E-Waste Management Rules 2022 and Plastic Waste Management Rules
Experience with CPCB portal filings and documentation
Excellent communication and client-facing skills
Degree in Environmental Science, Law, or related field

title: Business Development Executive
description: Drive new business acquisition by identifying corporates, manufacturers, and IT companies that require e-waste collection and recycling services. Build relationships, present solutions, and close deals to grow our client base across Western India.
requirements: 2-4 years of B2B sales experience, preferably in waste management, sustainability, or environmental services
Strong network in IT, manufacturing, or BFSI sectors
Ability to prepare proposals, quotations, and presentations
Own vehicle and willingness to travel across Gujarat and Maharashtra
MBA or equivalent preferred

title: Accounts & Admin Officer
description: Handle accounts payable/receivable, GST returns, TDS filings, and general administrative tasks. Maintain vendor records, coordinate with auditors, and support HR with payroll processing.
requirements: 3+ years of experience in accounting and office administration
Proficiency in Tally Prime, MS Excel, and GST portal
Knowledge of TDS, GST, and income tax compliance
B.Com or M.Com with relevant certifications preferred
Organised, reliable, and good with documentation
